description: The column "Translated subject" in the message list of Thunderbird, filled by the background script of the experimental build.

functions.name: add
functions.description: Adds the column with the given header, again with a new header when it exists.

functions.name: set
functions.description: Takes over translations as [subject, translation] pairs and fills the rows of every message list again.

functions.name: show
functions.description: Makes the column visible in the folders the message lists show now; resolves with the number of message lists changed.

functions.name: inspect
functions.description: The state of the column in a mail tab: registered, visible, table view, the number of translations, and for the first rows the subject, the text of the column and the text of its cell on screen.
